name: r2-lib-cublaslt-fp16-tmaconv
author: solx-loop
description: Lineage A / E1 (H18). For W%4==0 rows the depthwise conv K1 stages x through a 3-D TMA tensor map ({W,H,B*C} fp32, box {W+8, RT+6, CS} starting at w=-4, h=h0-3) with hardware zero fill, in a 4-deep mbarrier ring over a channel group. Threads take 4 output columns x 2 rows of one channel each (lane along w, so LDS.128 is conflict-free and LN partial sums stay in registers without shuffles) and write d channel-major (fp16 d[c][m]; GEMM1 now reads it with transB=T). K1 cold, rented: 1,96,56,56 5.9
